fee_notes: $30,000 for Traditional (first unit); $25,000 for existing franchisees in good standing adding units; $15,000 for Non-Traditional. 20% discount for qualifying veterans (VetFran) and first responders with 10+ years experience. Area Development Fee of $12,500 per unit committed after the first.
raw_excerpt: For each Traditional Store, you must pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $30,000. For each Non-Traditional Store, you must pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $15,000.
